During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established a '''garrison''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Flankers]] in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]]. Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the garrison was abandoned due to the [[Flankers system/Legends|Flankers system's]] [[Star/Legends|sun]] going [[Supernova/Legends|nova]].<ref name="Missing" />

An Imperial [[Scout ship/Legends|scout vessel]], carrying an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lens Reekeene]], arrived at the garrison after being damaged. Finding the base abandoned, the crew of the ship sent for rescue. [[Green squad]], a unit of the [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]], successfully infiltrated the base and rescued Reekeene before the sun exploded.<ref name="Missing" />
